submission.justification: Mixture-G1 with a 1.75 mm gas gap is the recommended configuration as it achieves the best time resolution (1.274 ns) among all compliant options. This provides a healthy 0.226 ns margin below the 1.5 ns requirement while meeting the GWP100 constraint (150, exactly at the limit). Mixture-G3 was eliminated due to excessive GWP100 (1000), and Mixture-G2, despite having the lowest GWP100 (50), could not achieve the required time resolution at any tested gap configuration. The 1.75 mm gap represents an optimal balance within the allowed 1-3 mm range, providing superior performance compared to other G1 configurations tested.
